properties.statement: Taken with tools/smoke_mcp.Server against /home/ajs7/project/xrt-demo/.reflow2/graph (not locked; no writes). get_node cmp:agent-seam → level "system", status planned. hierarchy_issues → one finding: orphan_level on cmp:agent-seam, "'cmp:agent-seam' (system) is not contained by anything above it and contains nothing below it"; no level_spine_disagreement, and none of the other ten components fires (they have parents or children). Since orphan_level's has_higher_parent accepts a Project parent, the absence of the finding under a Project CONTAINS edge is what the code already does; the edge is simply not there. So the root cause resolves to: the genesis skill says "contains each new node under the Project" and the agent did not for this one; the finding's message names the condition and not that cure, so the agent turned the only knob the message mentioned (level) and found both settings wrong. The joint-exemption candidate (a) is latent, not the cause here. FIX (his word): orphan_level's message says "if this is a top-level part, contain it under the Project with `contains`"; and the genesis and adopt skills say the same where they tell the agent to nest. No schema change.
